title: Feature: Elder's Counsel
rationale: PM prompt: Add an “Elder's Counsel” card at the Basic Toolmaking research handoff that reminds the player their next task is Basic Toolmaking and to check its wood cost in Research before spending timber elsewhere, with a parchment emblem and an Elder line.

feature_plugin.title: Elder's Counsel
